paper.title: Image Generators are Generalist Vision Learners

research_equation.one_sentence_thesis: A powerful image generator already contains broad semantic and geometric priors, but free-form RGB generation is not reliably measurable; low-ratio instruction tuning plus invertible RGB protocols turns that latent capability into one prompt-driven, benchmarkable vision interface.
research_equation.broken_assumption: visual understanding requires task-specific architectures and native structured output heads
research_equation.hard_setting: one shared model must retain generation while supporting diverse 2D and 3D benchmark outputs
research_equation.borrowed_tool: LLM-style instruction tuning of a generative base model
research_equation.unavailable_mechanism: a separate reliable task head, loss, and output structure for every vision task
research_equation.surrogate_mechanism: natural-language prompts plus decodable RGB answer images and deterministic codecs

direction_reconstruction.starting_dissatisfaction: Zero-shot image and video generators could draw depth-, normal-, and segmentation-like images, yet their outputs did not obey a strict format and could not be trusted on modern quantitative benchmarks.
direction_reconstruction.almost_worked_transfer: Task-specific repurposing of diffusion generators could achieve SOTA dense prediction, but used specialist modules or full finetuning and lost the desired generality.
direction_reconstruction.blocking_constraint: A generalist image generator has only an RGB output interface, while benchmarks expect masks, metric scalars, vectors, and task-specific structures.
direction_reconstruction.replacement_logic: Encode every supported answer as an invertible RGB visualization and teach the base generator to follow that protocol with a low ratio of vision-task examples mixed into its original training distribution.

challenge_module_map.challenge: Free-form generation is not quantitatively decodable
challenge_module_map.failure_mode: Prompted colors and layouts drift, so masks or physical values cannot be recovered reliably
challenge_module_map.module: Prompted RGB protocols for segmentation, metric depth, and surface normals
challenge_module_map.ablation_or_evidence: Standard benchmark results after deterministic decoding

challenge_module_map.challenge: Multi-task alignment may erase generation capability
challenge_module_map.failure_mode: The base model becomes a perception specialist
challenge_module_map.module: Very-low-ratio vision data mixed with original NBP training data
challenge_module_map.ablation_or_evidence: 53.5% GenAI-Bench and 47.8% ImgEdit pairwise win rates versus NBP

challenge_module_map.challenge: Unknown instance counts prevent fixed prompt colors
challenge_module_map.failure_mode: The prompt cannot enumerate a color for every instance in advance
challenge_module_map.design_principle: Restrict one inference to one semantic class and let the generator allocate colors dynamically
challenge_module_map.module: Per-class instance segmentation plus color clustering
challenge_module_map.ablation_or_evidence: SA-Co/Gold zero-shot performance and qualitative instance examples

challenge_module_map.challenge: Metric depth is unbounded while RGB is bounded
challenge_module_map.failure_mode: A naive color scale either loses near-field precision or cannot represent the full distance range
challenge_module_map.design_principle: Allocate more code space to nearby geometry while retaining invertibility
challenge_module_map.module: Power transform followed by a piecewise-linear RGB-cube path

module_lenses.failure_fixed: Unstructured generator outputs cannot be scored as standard vision predictions
module_lenses.ideal_unavailable_solution: A native structured decoder and task head for each benchmark family
module_lenses.available_proxy: The generator's native RGB image output and natural-language instruction following
module_lenses.hidden_assumption: The model can obey pixel-level color constraints accurately enough for deterministic decoding
module_lenses.future_direction: Constrained RGB decoding, explicit protocol tokens, and calibrated output-validity checks

module_lenses.failure_fixed: Infinite metric depth range and nonuniform task utility do not fit naive bounded colors
module_lenses.ideal_unavailable_solution: Direct calibrated real-valued regression with the general generator
module_lenses.available_proxy: A power-warped scalar encoded along RGB-cube edges
module_lenses.hidden_assumption: Off-path RGB generation errors remain small and nearest-path projection does not amplify physical error catastrophically
module_lenses.future_direction: Learn an error-equalizing codec and propagate RGB uncertainty into metric-depth confidence

module_lenses.failure_fixed: Task alignment may cause catastrophic forgetting of image generation
module_lenses.ideal_unavailable_solution: Perfectly lossless task alignment with no base-model update
module_lenses.available_proxy: Mix small vision-task supervision into the original generation mixture
module_lenses.hidden_assumption: Task formatting can be learned from little data and the new supervision does not carry most of the task knowledge
module_lenses.future_direction: Controlled data-scaling and pretraining-objective ablations that separate unlocking from relearning

module_lenses.failure_fixed: The number of instances is unknown before inference
module_lenses.ideal_unavailable_solution: Permutation-invariant set prediction with an explicit instance decoder
module_lenses.available_proxy: Per-class generation followed by thresholded color clustering
module_lenses.hidden_assumption: Different objects receive separable colors and internal texture does not fragment a mask
module_lenses.future_direction: Permutation-invariant learned color allocation and topology-aware mask decoding

citation_logic.citation_cluster: Wiedemer et al. 2025; Zuo et al. 2025
citation_logic.assumption_inherited: Strong generators exhibit emergent visual understanding in their outputs
citation_logic.paper_move: Turn qualitative zero-shot behavior into strictly formatted, quantitatively benchmarked outputs

citation_logic.citation_cluster: Marigold; Lotus/Lotus-2; StableNormal; Depth Anything 3; SAM 3
citation_logic.narrative_function: method ancestry and strong baseline pressure
citation_logic.assumption_inherited: Generation priors or specialist architectures can solve dense perception effectively
citation_logic.paper_move: Remove per-task model specialization and compete using one shared generative interface

citation_logic.assumption_inherited: Generative base models contain broad capabilities that instruction tuning can align to task formats
citation_logic.paper_move: Translate text-generation task following into RGB-generation task following

experiment_story_map.claim_supported: One shared model can perform strong zero-shot semantic, instance, and referring segmentation
experiment_story_map.counterfactual: A general image generator cannot match specialist segmentation systems without task-specific heads
experiment_story_map.stress_condition: Four datasets with open-vocabulary and reasoning-oriented prompts

experiment_story_map.claim_supported: Synthetic-only instruction alignment can unlock strong absolute-scale priors without camera parameters
experiment_story_map.counterfactual: Metric depth requires specialist regression and intrinsics
experiment_story_map.stress_condition: Six real-world domains and shared-dataset comparison with Depth Anything 3

experiment_story_map.claim_supported: The RGB interface extends to 3D local geometry and can rival diffusion specialists
experiment_story_map.counterfactual: A general generator's normal maps are too coarse for geometric evaluation
experiment_story_map.stress_condition: Indoor and outdoor datasets, including a benchmark on which Lotus-2 was trained

experiment_story_map.experiment: GenAI-Bench and ImgEdit pairwise human evaluations
experiment_story_map.claim_supported: Low-ratio visual instruction tuning largely preserves NBP generation
experiment_story_map.counterfactual: Dense prediction alignment catastrophically forgets the original generative prior
experiment_story_map.stress_condition: Both text-to-image generation and image editing

story_patterns.formula: missing task head Y + native generator interface X -> invertible RGB surrogate Z
story_patterns.lesson: When a foundation model appears incapable, first test whether the missing piece is an interface rather than a representation.

story_patterns.formula: shared weights + prompt-routed protocols + task-specific deterministic decoders
story_patterns.lesson: A paper can earn generality through a common protocol even when the physical meaning of each output differs.

story_patterns.formula: strong post-tuning transfer does not identify whether capability was unlocked or relearned
story_patterns.lesson: The strongest follow-up paper attacks the causal assumption behind the original success, not merely one more benchmark.

boundary_directions.title: Causal accounting of generative pretraining
boundary_directions.hidden_assumption: Very-low-ratio instruction tuning only formats capabilities already present in NBP
boundary_directions.what_breaks: If task supervision learns most of the representation, the title-level conclusion no longer follows from the benchmark results
boundary_directions.new_direction: Hold task data and compute fixed across generative, discriminative, frozen, and random-initialization bases with scaling curves

boundary_directions.title: Calibrated generative codecs
boundary_directions.hidden_assumption: Generated colors stay close enough to the valid task manifold for deterministic decoding
boundary_directions.what_breaks: Small RGB errors can fragment masks or become large metric-depth errors after inversion
boundary_directions.new_direction: Learn task-metric-aware code manifolds, output validity scores, and uncertainty propagation

boundary_directions.title: Temporal and interactive generalist vision
boundary_directions.hidden_assumption: Per-frame RGB answers are sufficient for general visual understanding
boundary_directions.what_breaks: Video, tracking, identity, action, and embodied control require temporal consistency and closed-loop correction
boundary_directions.new_direction: Use video generators and interactive correction protocols to produce temporally coherent structured visual outputs

boundary_directions.title: Efficient universal-to-specialist transfer
boundary_directions.hidden_assumption: A flagship image generator is affordable enough to serve directly as a perception model
boundary_directions.what_breaks: Latency, memory, and energy make the method impractical despite accuracy
boundary_directions.new_direction: Distill the unified prompt-and-codec behavior into compact students without losing cross-task transfer
